text.en:
Barangay Bagong Clarin in the Municipality of Clarin; Barangays Tuno, Lalud and Lampasan in
the Municipality of Tudela; Barangay Napangan in the Municipality of Sinacaban; Barangays Nueva Vista
(Mansawan), Gandawan and Liboron in the Municipality of Jimenez; Barangays Maramara and Petianan in
the Municipality of Bonifacio; and the sitios located on the other side of Mt. Malindang Range of Barangay
San Juan, in the Municipality of Panaon, and Barangay Sinampongan in the Municipality of Aloran, all
situated in the Province of Misamis Occidental, are hereby detached and separated from their respective
mother municipalities and constituted into a separate and independent municipality to be known as the
Municipality of Don Mariano Marcos in the Province of Misamis Occidental.
The seat of government of the new municipality created herein shall be in Barangay Tuno.
